title: thaspium trifoliatum
intro: Thaspium trifoliatum, commonly known as American cow parsley or meadow celery, is a perennial plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Thaspium trifoliatum are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
